_comment: F31/R-24 third control: an anchor that occurs MORE THAN ONCE is as unusable as one that is absent -- mutation_kill applies the replacement to the first match only, so an ambiguous anchor silently mutates a site the author did not mean. 'pdfe_sweep_fixture' appears twice in tools/gate/fixtures/mutant_sweep_target.cpp (namespace open and close comment), so the sweep must report FX20 FAIL and exit 2. See tools/gate/test_mutation_manifest_sweep.py.

mutants.note: AMBIGUOUS ON PURPOSE: two occurrences in the fixture target.
